jm: Kříž · myšlenka ze zdroje (Blank, střed) · Opus
pokyn: AFTER THE READING — after everything else, on a new line beginning with ✦, one more short line set apart: a thought offered for the seeker to carry away, grown from what the Blank rune is, not from the picture. Its source: "The Blank rune bears no sign, nothing to lean on. It is a pause in a story." Let it grow out of that, but say it in your own words. A quiet question or a still line. Never what to do, never a claim about what they feel or know.
text:
At the centre of this field the light has not yet fallen, and the ground there holds no mark you can name. Where the sun rides lowest, a line runs straight across the grass, the kind of track made by someone who walked without turning aside, whatever it cost them. Beneath that line lie older prints the light has not reached, pressed into the soil by weather and chance, waiting on an angle of sun that may or may not come. Some of them were laid down long ago, when the field was seeded and nothing showed above the earth for a season, and those steps are still holding their shape under everything grown since. If the light keeps its present angle, the whole trail stands out at once, every mark lit and legible across the open ground. This is what the field looks like from where you stand, Kuky, before the sun moves on and the grass goes flat and plain again.
✦ A page with no sign on it is not empty — what would you call the space between one thing and the next?

text:
The wet rope had swollen around the knot, and the fibres had pressed so close that pulling could not loosen it. Your path meets that fixed resistance here; force has its limit. Now the knot holds while the question of direction comes into focus. You can see the strain in each part of the rope, though what must bear it is not yet clear. If the rope stays taut, a shift may show where the knot can move, though nothing has opened yet. This may be a path still held fast, or one whose direction is beginning to change.
✦ A closed vessel keeps part of its contents unknown, however carefully you guess.
